notes: Dimension 1 baseline SUPERSEDES the earlier F1 0.64 (mistral-medium-2505) and 0.55 (ministral-8b-2512) figures. Two scorer corrections make those numbers non-comparable, and both can only lower a score: (1) a photo where the model identified nothing now counts as a zero instead of being dropped from the mean; (2) 'green onion' no longer matches ground-truth 'onion' (a scallion is not a bulb onion). A lower number than 0.55 is therefore not by itself a model regression.
Dimension 2 now enforces hand-authored constraints (eval/cases.py) in addition to what the pipeline extracted, whole-word avoid matching, and a dimension verdict that requires every case to pass.

Dimension 2 corrections after run_1793926853: expectations for d2_10, d2_12 and d2_30 were corrected (see eval/cases.py CORRECTIONS); only a user-STATED cook-time limit is enforced by the scorer, not the profile default. The pipeline changed too: stated-vs-default cook time, relaxation on 'nothing cookable', code-level avoid-list exclusion, and a deterministic dietary-restriction backstop. Compare this run to run_1793926853 with those changes in mind; they are not like-for-like.
